description: Figure: GUK1 catalytic residues mapped onto LRGUK and MAGUK GUK domains, and their conservation across LRGUK orthologs
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
D=json.load(open("out/seqs.json")); S=D["seqs"]; G=S["GUK1_HUMAN"]
rm=pd.read_csv("out/residue_map.csv")
odf=pd.read_csv("out/ortholog_catalytic_residues.csv")

targets=["KGUA_YEAST","LRGUK_HUMAN","LRGUK_MOUSE","MPP1_HUMAN","DLG1_HUMAN","DLG4_HUMAN","CSKP_HUMAN"]
labels={"KGUA_YEAST":"Yeast GUK1\n(active)","LRGUK_HUMAN":"LRGUK human","LRGUK_MOUSE":"LRGUK mouse",
        "MPP1_HUMAN":"MPP1 GK","DLG1_HUMAN":"DLG1 GK","DLG4_HUMAN":"PSD-95 GK","CSKP_HUMAN":"CASK GK"}
rm=rm.sort_values("GUK1_pos")
order=rm.drop_duplicates("GUK1_pos").reset_index(drop=True)

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,1,height_ratios=[1.25,1],hspace=0.42)

# ---- Panel A: residue identity grid ----
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
npos=len(order); ntg=len(targets)
cols=[]
for ti,t in enumerate(targets):
    row=[]
    for pi,r in order.iterrows():
        v=rm[(rm.GUK1_pos==r.GUK1_pos)][t].iloc[0]
        if v=="-": row.append(0)                       # gap / deleted
        elif v[0]==r.GUK1_res: row.append(2)           # identical
        else: row.append(1)                            # substituted
    cols.append(row)
Mx=np.array(cols)
cmap=plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#9aa0a6","#d94a3d","#2e7d5b"])
ax.imshow(Mx,cmap=cmap,vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect="auto")
for ti,t in enumerate(targets):
    for pi,r in order.iterrows():
        v=rm[(rm.GUK1_pos==r.GUK1_pos)][t].iloc[0]
        ax.text(pi,ti,v[0] if v!="-" else "·",ha="center",va="center",
                color="white",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_yticks(range(ntg)); ax.set_yticklabels([labels[t] for t in targets],fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(range(npos))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r.GUK1_res}{r.GUK1_pos}" for _,r in order.iterrows()],rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Catalytic and ligand-binding positions, human GUK1 numbering",fontsize=11)
ax.set_title("A. Catalytic residues of guanylate kinase mapped onto LRGUK and MAGUK GUK domains\n"
             "(Smith-Waterman, BLOSUM62, reference = human GUK1 Q16774)",fontsize=12,loc="left")
# site brackets
bounds=[(0,8,"P-loop / Walker A"),(9,19,"GMP pocket"),(20,22,"catalytic Arg"),(23,24,"ATP lid")]
for a,b,lab in bounds:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((a-0.5,-0.5),b-a+1,ntg,fill=False,ec="black",lw=1.8))
    ax.text((a+b)/2,-0.78,lab,ha="center",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_ylim(ntg-0.5,-1.1)
ax.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color="#2e7d5b",label="identical to GUK1"),
                   mpatches.Patch(color="#d94a3d",label="substituted"),
                   mpatches.Patch(color="#9aa0a6",label="gap / deleted in alignment")],
          loc="upper right",bbox_to_anchor=(1.0,-0.42),ncol=3,fontsize=9,frameon=False)

# ---- Panel B: ortholog conservation ----
ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
keycols=[c for c in odf.columns if c not in ("organism","acc","SWscore")]
cons=[100*(odf[c]==c[0]).mean() for c in keycols]
role=["fold","fold","ATP Lys","Mg2+ Ser/Thr","GMP","GMP","catalytic Arg","GMP","GMP","GMP","GMP","catalytic Arg","catalytic Arg"]
colr=["#2e7d5b" if v>=90 else ("#e8a33d" if v>=50 else "#d94a3d") for v in cons]
ax2.bar(range(len(keycols)),cons,color=colr)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(keycols)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([f"{c}\n{r}" for c,r in zip(keycols,role)],fontsize=9)
ax2.set_ylabel("% of LRGUK orthologs identical\nto human GUK1 residue",fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylim(0,108); ax2.axhline(50,ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
ax2.set_title("B. The degeneracy is fixed across 12 LRGUK orthologs from elephant shark to human\n"
              "(P-loop glycines and Lys retained; Mg2+ Ser/Thr, GMP-specificity and catalytic Arg lost)",
              fontsize=12,loc="left")
for i,v in enumerate(cons): ax2.text(i,v+2,f"{v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
for s in ("top","right"): ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
print(pd.DataFrame({"position":keycols,"role":role,"pct_conserved_in_LRGUK_orthologs":cons}).to_string(index=False))
